performers.name: Jason Didner and the GSPs
performers.description: Pure Jersey rock served up with a side of Jersey humor and a whole lot of heart.

performers.name: Lorraine
performers.description: High-energy pop-rock from a four-piece out of Summit, NJ.

performers.name: Daniel Scanfeld

performers.name: Avery Sinclair

performers.name: The Coverup

performers.name: Michael Sorensen

performers.name: Dizzy Lizard

performers.name: Tweezer
